title: Execution Trace Event v1
description: Schema contract for one JSONL event in the execution-trace/v1 stream. Each line represents one repo Node tool execution; the aggregated execution-trace/v1 artifact is produced by a collector and is intentionally separate from this per-event contract.
$comment: Versioning rules: keep traceVersion=execution-trace/v1 while field names, meanings, and required structure remain compatible. Additive optional fields may stay on v1 only when old consumers can ignore them. Renaming required fields, changing status semantics, or turning the event into an aggregated artifact requires a new traceVersion.

traceRunId.description: Optional run-level id used by collectors to group related JSONL events.

sequence.description: Optional zero-based order inside one trace run.

toolName.description: Repo-local Node CLI name, normally a tools_node/*.js basename or logical wrapper name.

argsHash.description: Hash of normalized arguments; raw argument payloads are intentionally not stored in the event.

exitCode.description: Process exit code. Spawn/setup failures that cannot produce a code should be represented as status=error with exitCode=1 and stderrSummary explaining the failure.

metadata.description: Small scalar-only extension bag for collector-safe facts. Do not store raw stdout, stderr, absolute paths, or secrets here.
